findings.summary: DropdownMenuLabel (Base UI GroupLabel) throws 'MenuGroupContext is missing' when used outside DropdownMenuGroup. Both the gallery demo and UserSettings put the label directly in the content.
Base UI DropdownMenuContent is styled w-(--anchor-width), fixing width to the trigger width; long items wrap.
Translucent menu preset: backdrop-blur does not paint in Chromium (cn-menu-translucent).
Base UI dropdown causes scrollbar flash and layout shift in RTL.
Opening Base UI MenuTrigger re-renders a virtualized grid (Radix does not).
Stray dark class in base-ui dropdown-menu.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog searches were not run; only GitHub issue lists for mui/base-ui and shadcn-ui/ui were queried (radix-ui/primitives not queried).

differences.where: DropdownMenuLabel outside DropdownMenuGroup (gallery demo and UserSettings)
differences.reference: Label renders anywhere inside the content
differences.branch: Throws 'Base UI: MenuGroupContext is missing' on opening the menu and unmounts the whole React tree (blank page)
differences.how: Swap to base-nova dropdown-menu, open /gallery#components, click Open menu. Console shows the error. Fix needs the label moved inside a Group (done only as a temporary experiment) in both consumers.

differences.reference: Trigger keeps its normal outline background while the menu is open
differences.branch: Trigger looked lighter while open (screenshot with pointer over it; possibly hover plus popup-open state); not isolated
differences.how: Open menu and compare the Open menu button in both builds

differences.reference: Radix sets body style pointer-events: none and overflow hidden
differences.branch: Base UI sets only overflow: hidden on body (outside click still closed the menu and did not trigger the button underneath)

differences.reference: Radix nova width is w-(--radix-dropdown-menu-trigger-width) min-w-32, overridden by w-56 in the demo
differences.branch: base-nova uses w-(--anchor-width) (see shadcn #12330); same in the demo because w-56 overrides, but UserSettings uses only min-w-48 so width could differ

apiChanges: asChild on DropdownMenuTrigger and DropdownMenuItem becomes render={...} with children moved
Radix Content becomes Positioner plus Popup; icon placeholders replaced with lucide icons
onCheckedChange/onValueChange signatures gain an event-details second argument
notes: Experimental swap was applied temporarily to compare, then reverted with git checkout. Compared at 1280x900 dark with the Label wrapped in a Group: menu geometry (328.5,191.5,224x274), items, roles, aria-checked/aria-disabled, ArrowDown/End focus movement, Escape focus return and outside-click dismissal matched. Not checked: 390x844, submenu, UserSettings consumer, enter/exit animation timing, type-ahead, Tab, reduced motion, touch.
reasonNotMoved: The base-nova DropdownMenuLabel is Menu.GroupLabel, which throws 'MenuGroupContext is missing' unless wrapped in a Group (open upstream: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/9117). Both consumers (gallery demo, UserSettings avatar menu) render a label directly in the content, so the swapped build crashes the entire app on opening the menu; the result is a high safety finding plus a visible difference. Also open: width tied to trigger (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12330) and translucent blur issue (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12112). Retry when #9117 is fixed upstream or when the labels are wrapped in DropdownMenuGroup by the consumer (an API change to accept), then recheck the open-trigger look, body pointer-events and UserSettings width.
